representation.forecast_path: history -> encoder output -> shared per-channel head -> horizon; v3 identity has no projection and requires encoder width H
representation.linear_rank_bound: With single composition, raw preprocessing (no input-dependent normalization, centering or restoration), temporal/independent fusion, and a linear head, the linear/DLinear affine temporal map has rank at most latent_dim. This is not the original direct context-to-horizon DLinear.

mechanisms.moving_average_decomposition: Moving-average trend/residual split in DLinear or series_decomposition preprocessing.
mechanisms.learned_residual_backcast: Generic NBeats learned backcast and latent forecast residual blocks; no fixed polynomial/Fourier basis.
mechanisms.multiscale_patches: Multiple patch lengths/strides in multiscale_patch embedding; not N-HiTS multirate pooling/interpolation.
mechanisms.fixed_trend_basis: Unsupported: no fixed polynomial trend basis.
mechanisms.fixed_seasonal_basis: Unsupported: no fixed Fourier seasonal basis.
mechanisms.direct_horizon_forecast: V3 identity head passes an already H-wide encoder forecast through without any additional projection.

linear.implementation: Context-to-latent affine encoder. Explicit shared=true uses one Linear across channels; shared=false uses a separate Linear per channel (legacy schema default false). Neither implies cross-channel mixing. The prediction head is separately shared. bias is supported here and in dlinear, with schema default true; omission does not disable bias.

dlinear.implementation: Fixed moving-average kernel (odd kernel_size), then learned trend and residual context-to-latent projections summed. Explicit individual=false shares those projections across channels; individual=true uses per-channel projections. No learned decomposition kernel. Requires embedding=none; do not also add series_decomposition. bias is supported here and in linear, with schema default true; preserve its comparison value in a matched control.

nbeats.implementation: Generic learned MLP residual backcast and latent-forecast blocks. hidden_dim, n_blocks and n_layers set capacity. Requires embedding=none. No interpretable polynomial/Fourier basis and no N-HiTS multirate pooling.

timesnet_lite.implementation: Paper-derived FFT-period convolution proxy; hidden_dim, n_layers, top_k, kernel_size and dropout. Requires embedding=none. Not native/full TimesNet.

mlp.implementation: With embedding=none, Linear(context_length,hidden_dim) reads the whole history, followed by nonlinear hidden layers and a latent projection: already a global temporal receptive field, not a pointwise time MLP. With an embedding, residual MLP blocks act on individual embedding tokens before readout; no complex FreMLP or inverse FFT. depth, hidden_dim, activation and dropout control the network. Patch/multiscale_patch with MLP/Transformer/TCN uses per-token feature LayerNorm, feature-major/token-position flattening and Linear(D*N, latent_dim) before the unchanged prediction head. unfold has no tail padding; N=floor((L-patch_len)/stride)+1. Scales concatenate in recipe order. Recompute parameters and retrain; old mean-readout checkpoints are incompatible.

transformer.implementation: Self-attention encoder over the selected embedding tokens; d_model must divide by n_heads. Token meaning depends on embedding (patch=time patches, invert=variable tokens). Head projects latent to horizon; not automatically a specific published Transformer architecture. Patch/multiscale_patch with MLP/Transformer/TCN uses per-token feature LayerNorm, feature-major/token-position flattening and Linear(D*N, latent_dim) before the unchanged prediction head. unfold has no tail padding; N=floor((L-patch_len)/stride)+1. Scales concatenate in recipe order. Recompute parameters and retrain; old mean-readout checkpoints are incompatible.

tcn.implementation: Stacked temporal convolutions mapped to latent features; hidden_dim, n_layers, kernel_size, activation and dropout. Supports none, patch and multiscale_patch. Raw input retains its original final-position readout. Patch tokens feed temporal convolutions over the token axis; LayerNorm/flatten uses convolution hidden_dim. Multi-scale convolution crosses scale boundaries, which are not a uniformly sampled time axis; GroupNorm does not ensure strict token causality. Not a state-space recurrence.

rnn.implementation: GRU/LSTM/vanilla RNN over regularly sampled input tokens (cell, hidden_dim, num_layers, dropout). No irregular-time handling merely from choosing RNN. Tokenization changes the sequence being modeled.

gated_depthwise_conv.implementation: Gated depthwise temporal convolution blocks with hidden_dim/depth/kernel_size/dropout. No recurrent state or selective scan; not Mamba/SSM.

mixer.implementation: Token/time and feature MLP mixing inside the backbone (temporal_mixing/channel_mixing), controlled by hidden_dim/depth/dropout. Internal feature dimensions are not automatically target-variable mixing.

diagonal_ssm.implementation: Real stable diagonal state-space recurrence with ZOH discretization. d_model<=512, state_dim<=512, depth<=8. Raw embedding=none retains explicit sequence_latent/channel_sequence and mean/last readout. Single-scale patch requires channel_sequence/flatten, temporal/independent fusion and equal embedding/backbone d_model; channels share parameters without mixing. No multiscale Patch; not Mamba selective scanning.

timesblock_encoder.implementation: Sample-local FFT period selection and Inception 2D TimesBlock encoder. d_model<=512, d_ff<=2048, depth<=8, top_k<=min(16,floor(context_length/2)), num_kernels<=8. embedding=none, sequence readout required. Not full TimesNet.

mamba.implementation: Mamba-1 selective state-space encoder. backend=auto prefers the verified official CUDA selective scan on CUDA with d_state<=256 and otherwise reports a torch_reference fallback; cuda_optimized strictly requires that kernel/device/state bound and never silently falls back. torch_reference explicitly preserves the recurrent reference. d_model<=512,d_state<=512,d_conv<=32,expand<=4,depth<=8; state dimensions above 256 use reference in auto. Raw embedding=none retains mean/last readout. Single-scale patch requires channel_sequence/flatten, temporal/independent fusion and equal embedding/backbone d_model; channels share parameters without mixing. No multiscale Patch. Parameter keys/shapes and streaming reference are preserved; manifests and experiment identities record the actual backend and binary provenance.

preprocessing.last_value_centering: Subtract each channel's last observed value, then restore it to predictions. Input-dependent centering, not trend decomposition; required explicitly for an NLinear-style experiment.
preprocessing.instance_norm: Normalize each instance/channel over its context window and restore scale/location on forecasts; eps numerical stability, affine optional learned scale/shift. No running-statistics batch normalization.
preprocessing.series_decomposition: FIXED moving-average split using odd kernel_size (3..255); method=moving_average. Learned Linear(context,H) predicts trend; residual goes through encoder/head, then trend prediction is added back. Trainable prediction branch, NOT a learnable decomposition kernel. Do not combine with DLinear.
preprocessing.seasonal_differencing: Subtract lag-period observations with seasonal_period; forecast inversion recursively restores the seasonal reference. Changes the forecasting transform; not a learned seasonal basis. Gaussian inversion unsupported without joint covariance.
preprocessing.missing_mask: Append observed/missing indicator channels, first action only, mask_channel=true. Requires cross-variable fusion so masks affect target outputs; not an imputation algorithm.
preprocessing.sample_reweighting: Training loss sample weights, not a forward transform. scheme=uniform gives equal weights; outlier_robust uses 1/(1+mean(abs(target))); horizon_tail uses 1+mean(abs(last quarter of target)). Normalize weights by batch mean. None reads time indices: recency weighting is unsupported.

embedding.none: Use raw context representation required by dlinear/tcn/nbeats/timesnet_lite and sequence encoders.
embedding.patch: Fixed-length sliding time patches (patch_len,stride), projected to d_model. Changes time-token granularity. Patch/multiscale_patch with MLP/Transformer/TCN uses per-token feature LayerNorm, feature-major/token-position flattening and Linear(D*N, latent_dim) before the unchanged prediction head. unfold has no tail padding; N=floor((L-patch_len)/stride)+1. Scales concatenate in recipe order. Recompute parameters and retrain; old mean-readout checkpoints are incompatible.
embedding.multiscale_patch: Multiple patch_len/stride scales projected into tokens; more than one scale provides multiscale_patches. Not N-HiTS multirate pooling or forecast interpolation. Patch/multiscale_patch with MLP/Transformer/TCN uses per-token feature LayerNorm, feature-major/token-position flattening and Linear(D*N, latent_dim) before the unchanged prediction head. unfold has no tail padding; N=floor((L-patch_len)/stride)+1. Scales concatenate in recipe order. Recompute parameters and retrain; old mean-readout checkpoints are incompatible.
embedding.invert: Variable tokens constructed from each variable's history; d_model projection. Token axis is variables rather than time.
embedding.frequency: rFFT over each input history, retain n_freq bins, use magnitude or stacked real/imag features, then a real Linear(feature_dim,d_model). No complex-valued frequency MLP, learnable spectral split, inverse FFT or frequency-to-time reconstruction; not FreTS/FreMLP.
embedding.calendar: Embeds explicitly available calendar fields using embed_dim; requires supplied calendar features. Does not grant access to unknown future target/covariate values.

fusion.temporal: channel_mode=independent leaves channels unmixed; shared is a legacy alias of feature_mlp ChannelMixer. This field controls cross-channel mixing, NOT encoder parameter sharing. Use feature_mlp explicitly.
fusion.feature_mlp: Input ChannelMixer exchanges information between target/input channels. Independent of linear.shared and head parameter sharing.
fusion.variate_attention: Attention across channel latent tokens after temporal encoding; number of heads must be compatible with latent width.
fusion.temporal_then_feature: Temporal encoding followed by ordered channel-latent mixing; gate and residual are explicit options.
fusion.feature_then_temporal: Ordered channel mixing on history before temporal encoding; gate and residual are explicit options.
fusion.graph: Input graph channel mixing. adjacency_source=static requires topology_artifact with ordered channel_names/adjacency; correlation fits training rows only; learned learns adjacency. sparsity controls graph sparsity.
fusion.gated_hybrid: Mix temporal latent with a feature-mixed history encoder. gate_type=learned is static learned channel weights; scalar/channel/time are input-dependent. Legacy time averages gates over history before latent mixing, not history_time_gate composition.

head.linear: Shared per-channel Linear(latent_dim,H) point forecast. Does not set encoder sharing and does not share parameters across different H models.
head.residual_correction: Shared Linear(latent,H) plus LayerNorm->Linear(correction_dim)->GELU->Dropout->Linear(H). Already a nonlinear residual MLP, not a plain linear correction. Dropout comes from backbone.dropout; DLinear has no supported dropout field.
head.quantile: Shared quantile projections with strictly increasing unique levels in (0,1); loss quantiles must match exactly and use quantile loss.
head.gaussian: Shared mean/positive-scale projections (variance_floor). Requires gaussian_nll and compatible inversion/fusion; does not model joint covariance.
head.identity: V3-only parameter-free point head. Requires explicit representation.latent_dim equal to every requested H (including secondary branches). With DLinear, raw preprocessing, none embedding and independent temporal fusion, the seasonal/trend Linear(context,H) forecasts sum directly.

composition.parallel_two_branch: Top-level primary and secondary={backbone,embedding,representation}. No nested compositions. Both branches must satisfy embedding/layout compatibility; temporal/independent fusion only. latent_gate requires equal latent widths; history_time_gate matching sequence layout/d_model/representation; forecast_step_gate mixes forecasts per step. Forecast merges require point heads. Global preprocessing runs before the branch paths and output restoration runs once. secondary.representation replaces the inherited representation and controls the secondary latent_dim, including for linear/tcn; do not infer that primary and secondary widths are necessarily identical.
composition.decomposition_two_branch: Fixed moving-average kernel_size splits history into trend for primary and residual for secondary; forecast sum. No learned split kernel. Both branches need explicit representations; temporal/independent fusion, no nesting. Removing secondary is an architecture change. Global preprocessing runs once on the complete input before this split. secondary.preprocessing=none prevents a second pass, not preprocessing of a separate uncentered history. Primary encodes the post-preprocessing trend; secondary encodes its residual. DLinear is forbidden in either branch because it already decomposes. secondary.representation replaces the inherited representation; its latent_dim is independently honored by all backbones including linear and tcn. Each sum branch may have its own latent width before its forecast head.

loss.mse: Squared point error; sensitive to residual magnitude.
loss.huber: Piecewise quadratic/linear point loss with delta; residual robustness, not recency weighting.
loss.quantile: Pinball loss at explicit sorted unique quantiles, matching quantile head.
loss.gaussian_nll: Gaussian likelihood loss using predicted mean and scale; matching Gaussian head required.
loss.distillation: Weighted supervised error and a last_value or moving_average teacher (window). supervised_weight/teacher_weight determine contributions; no external pretrained teacher implied.

optimizer.adam: Adam with lr and coupled weight_decay.
optimizer.adamw: AdamW with lr and decoupled weight_decay.
optimizer.sgd: SGD with lr and weight_decay; no momentum field in recipe schema.

scheduler.none: No base LR schedule (explicit warmup may still apply).
scheduler.one_cycle: OneCycleLR stepped per epoch, total_steps=max_epochs, max_lr=optimizer.lr; warmup_steps/max_epochs sets pct_start, otherwise 0.3.
scheduler.plateau: ReduceLROnPlateau on validation loss (runtime factor=0.5, patience=1; recipe only exposes type/warmup_steps).
scheduler.lradj_type2: Epoch-end fixed rates at epochs 2:5e-5,4:1e-5,6:5e-6,8:1e-6,10:5e-7,15:1e-7,20:5e-8; otherwise retain LR.
scheduler.lradj_type3: Base LR until epoch 3, then base_lr*0.9^(epoch-3).
scheduler.lradj_3: Multiply base LR by 0.1 at epoch 10.
scheduler.lradj_4: Multiply base LR by 0.1 at epoch 15.
scheduler.lradj_5: Multiply base LR by 0.1 at epoch 25.
scheduler.lradj_6: Multiply base LR by 0.1 at epoch 5.

experiment_contract.sharing: linear.shared=true corresponds to dlinear.individual=false for encoder weight sharing only. Head sharing and fusion mixing are separate. Explicitly choose these fields in both branches. For a matched dlinear-to-linear control, remove kernelSize and individual, add shared=true for individual=false, and preserve bias. Experiment constraints address normalized fields; removing a defaulted field does not disable it.
experiment_contract.representation: latent_dim integer 1..512. channel_latent uses readout=none. Raw sequence_latent/channel_sequence requires mean or last readout. Encoders output latent; heads project to H. A separate model/optimizer/checkpoint trains for each H. V3 identity point heads require explicit latent_dim=H; unequal multiple horizons are incompatible with one fixed-width identity recipe. Single-scale Patch+Mamba/Diagonal SSM requires channel_sequence/flatten: token-feature LayerNorm, transpose D/N, flatten D*N, project to latent. Raw sequences retain mean/last. history_time_gate requires identical embeddings/token grids in both branches; activation budgets count actual Patch tokens.
experiment_contract.constraints: System parameter budget is at most 10M summed across independently trained horizon models; smoke on one H does not establish full-budget feasibility. Unsupported known-future/static covariates; targets and observed-past only.
experiment_contract.training: warmup_steps means epochs, must be <max_epochs; grad_clip is gradient-norm clipping, not dropout. Module-level dropout only. Explicit seed/batch_size/max_epochs/patience/time_budget_s are experimental conditions, not interchangeable metadata.
experiment_contract.horizon_weighting: uniform gives equal horizon-position weights; front_heavy linearly weights 1.5 to 0.5; tail_heavy 0.5 to 1.5. learned_static currently falls back to uniform (no learned weights). All weight forecast positions, not sample time/recency.
